title: Sunburst chart
description: A hierarchy drawn as concentric rings: each ring is a level, each sector a share of its parent. Click a parent (or press Enter on it) to zoom in, click the center (or press Backspace) to go back up; the transition animates the angles and the rings. Hovering a sector highlights its ancestors and descendants, and the labels follow the arc or the radius, whichever fits.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: drill
props.description: Clicking (or Enter on) a parent zooms into it; clicking the center goes back up (default `true`)

props.name: labels
props.description: Sector labels along the arc or the radius, whichever fits best (`auto`), or none (default `auto`)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: data
props.description: Nodes: leaves carry a value, parents sum their children

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: levels
props.description: Rings shown at once below the focused node (default: every level)

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between the sectors, in pixels (default 1)

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Angle of the first node, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock (default 0)

props.name: innerRadius
props.description: Radius of the center circle as a fraction of the outer radius (default 0.26)

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description: Corner radius of the sectors, in pixels (default 2)

props.name: drillPath
props.description: Names from the root to the focused node (`[]` = the root); makes the drill-down controlled (clicks only emit `drill`)

// Disk usage as rings: folders inside, their content outside; click a
// folder to zoom into it, the center to go back up.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { SunburstChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: {
    folders: ["Documents", "Photos", "Music", "Apps"],
    files: [
      "Work",
      "Taxes",
      "2025",
      "2026",
      "Albums",
      "Podcasts",
      "Tools",
      "Games",
    ],
  },
  zh: {
    folders: ["文档", "照片", "音乐", "应用"],
    files: ["工作", "税务", "2025", "2026", "专辑", "播客", "工具", "游戏"],
  },
  ja: {
    folders: ["書類", "写真", "ミュージック", "アプリ"],
    files: [
      "仕事",
      "税金",
      "2025",
      "2026",
      "アルバム",
      "ポッドキャスト",
      "ツール",
      "ゲーム",
    ],
  },
  fr: {
    folders: ["Documents", "Photos", "Musique", "Applications"],
    files: [
      "Travail",
      "Impôts",
      "2025",
      "2026",
      "Albums",
      "Podcasts",
      "Outils",
      "Jeux",
    ],
  },
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const data = computed(() => {
  const text = TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en;
  return [
    {
      name: text.folders[0],
      children: [
        { name: text.files[0], value: 12 },
        { name: text.files[1], value: 3 },
      ],
    },
    {
      name: text.folders[1],
      children: [
        { name: text.files[2], value: 46 },
        { name: text.files[3], value: 21 },
      ],
    },
    {
      name: text.folders[2],
      children: [
        { name: text.files[4], value: 18 },
        { name: text.files[5], value: 7 },
      ],
    },
    {
      name: text.folders[3],
      children: [
        { name: text.files[6], value: 9 },
        { name: text.files[7], value: 32 },
      ],
    },
  ];
});
const format = (value: number) => `${value} GB`;
</script>

<template>
  <SunburstChart :data="data" :format="format" />
</template>

translationResources.title: Sunburst chart
translationResources.description: A hierarchy drawn as concentric rings: each ring is a level, each sector a share of its parent. Click a parent (or press Enter on it) to zoom in, click the center (or press Backspace) to go back up; the transition animates the angles and the rings. disk-usage.title: Disk usage
disk-usage.description: Folders and apps of a laptop, in GB. Click a folder to zoom into it and the center to go back up; onDrill reports the focused path, shown under the chart.

drill-down.title: Controlled drill-down with a breadcrumb
drill-down.description: drillPath makes the focus controlled: clicks only call onDrill, and the breadcrumb owns the path, so its buttons can jump to any level. cornerRadius and padAngle round and separate the sectors.

org.title: Organization
org.description: Headcount by department, group and team. levels={2} shows two rings at a time (drill down to see the teams), and labels="radial" writes the names along the radius.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Population by continent and country. labels chooses how the names are written: auto picks the arc or the radius per sector, and names that do not fit are shortened or skipped. The legend hides / shows continents; country names come from Intl.DisplayNames.

city-budget.title: City budget
city-budget.description: drill={false} turns a click into a selection instead of a zoom: onClick fills the line under the chart, which gives a program's share of the whole budget and of its policy area. renderTooltip shows the same text, and an area without programs is a plain leaf.

time-tracking.title: Time tracking
time-tracking.description: Hours by client, project and activity on three rings. A RadioGroup switches between the week and the month and the sectors animate; hours are formatted with Intl.NumberFormat's hour unit, and the summary gives the billable share.

live-requests.title: Live API traffic
live-requests.description: Requests per minute by service and endpoint, refreshed every 1.5 seconds (setInterval, cleared on pause and on unmount) with a seeded random walk. The total is shown but not announced; only a change of the busiest service is.

energy-mix.title: Electricity mix
energy-mix.description: The legend and a Switch edit the same controlled hidden list (onToggle), so hiding fossil fuels from either one stays in sync. A source without breakdown (nuclear) is a leaf on the first ring, and each source's color is inherited by its fuels.

props.noDrill: Disables the drill-down (clicking a parent zooms into it by default)
props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-drill: A parent or the center was clicked (or drill() called); detail: { path }
events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.drill: Zooms into the node at a path (names from the root, [] = the root)
methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
